steps.summary: Wide multi-lane asphalt road with white dashed center line markings
Tall building with distinctive triangular/pyramidal shape in the background, appearing to be a modern tower structure
Large mature trees lining both sides of the road, including what appear to be palm trees and broad-leafed tropical trees
Street light poles along the road
Multiple vehicles ahead on the road including trucks and sedans
Advertisement or banner signs mounted on light poles on the left side of the road
Overcast sky with white and gray clouds
Paved sidewalks on both sides of the road
Pedestrians visible on the left side of the road
Dry brown grass and vegetation on the right side of the road

The tall building with the distinctive triangular/pyramidal shape (e2) closely resembles the Kenyatta International Convention Centre (KICC) tower in Nairobi, Kenya, which has a recognizable helipad structure and antenna. The road layout, tropical vegetation including palm trees (e3), overcast weather typical of Nairobi's climate, and general urban East African appearance support this. Nairobi's Uhuru Highway/Kenyatta Avenue area has similar wide multi-lane roads with median dividers and mature trees.
